review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (VA Project 589A4-20-158, a warehouse renovation, Missouri), pulled from the corpus_2 GitHub Release during a fourth batch-survey pass (also covering 039_TX, 040_IL, 041_IL, 047_NC -- none swept this pass). Screened for image coverage first per Run 86's own established check: `imgRatio` reads 0.01 on this sheet, real vector CAD.

Sheet M-101's text scan found abundant already-parseable bare pipe callouts (`2"HWS`, `1"LPS`, `6"CWS`, etc., system suffix directly appended with no space -- already handled by this session's own Run 87 `normalizeLabelText` fix that inserts a space after a closing quote before a letter). A grid sweep of fifteen of them found this real, clean 14.83 LF straight `3"LPS` (3-inch low-pressure steam) pipe: `size:{kind:pipe,nps_in:3}`, `systems:["LPS"]`, confidence 0.5. A marked crop confirms it visually and unambiguously: a real vertical pipe labeled '3"LPS' directly on the run, from a real trap/pump fitting connection at the top to a real elbow-down connection at the bottom (a keynote reads '3" LPS DN TO HX1 AND WH...', a heat exchanger/water heater feed) -- both real, visually-confirmed fitting junctions, clearly distinct from the adjacent, separately-drawn `6"LPS` riser running parallel a short distance away (no stacked-parallel-pipe ambiguity here, unlike several nearby `CWS`/`CWR` pairs on this same sheet that were swept and declined -- see scope). `resolveRunSegments` reproduces the identical single segment (14.82 LF from its own per-segment rounding path vs. `trace_run`'s own reported 14.83 LF total -- the same small rounding-convention gap already established and accepted in `poultry-ra-m101.json`) and a reseed `trace_run` using the exact `bench:linear`-style seed (40% along the run's longest segment, per `seedOnLongestSegment` in `bench/linear.mts`, not an arbitrary working coordinate -- a verification-methodology correction made directly in response to Run 94's own seed-position-dependence finding on a different project) against the freshly re-loaded, already-committed raw PDF reproduces identical points, length, size, and system exactly.

Several nearby `CWS`/`CWR` candidates on this same sheet (closely stacked twin-pipe pairs, e.g. two `18"CWS`/`18"CWR` labels only ~24px apart, two `8"CWS`/`8"CWR` pairs) were swept and found to report a SYSTEM MISMATCH against the label nearest each individual seed (e.g., an `8"CWR`-labeled seed's own automatic bind read back `systems:["CWS"]`) -- a real instance of the twin-pipe label-crosstalk risk this corpus already tracks, not authored as goldens.
scope: A single real 3-inch low-pressure-steam (LPS) pipe segment (14.83 LF) on the 589A4 warehouse renovation project's own mechanical plan, sheet M-101, from a real trap/pump fitting connection to a real elbow-down connection feeding a heat exchanger/water heater. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the pipe's own continuation past either boundary (including the DN branch to HX1/WH); the adjacent, separately-drawn `6"LPS` riser visible in the same crop; the several `CWS`/`CWR` twin-pipe candidates on this same sheet noted in review_basis, none authored due to system-label crosstalk; every other pipe run on this same 90-sheet plan set, not attempted this pass.
